title: CPC-2025-4430-CA
text:
CPC-2025-4430-CA  Council Districts: Citywide
  CEQA: ENV-2020-6762-EIR; ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1;  Last Day to Act: 12-31-26
  ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2; ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD5
  Plan Area: Citywide
  Related Cases: CPC-2025-4421-CA; CPC-2026-4383-CA

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  Citywide

  PROPOSED CODE AMENDMENT:
  The Missing Middle LA (MMLA) Program proposes amendments to Chapters I and 1A of the Los Angeles
  Municipal Code to implement the City’s 2021–2029 Housing Element, incorporate state housing laws, and
  expand opportunities for smaller-scale for-sale and rental housing citywide. This Proposed Code Amendment
  includes:

  Update to Small Lot Subdivision regulations, codify the standards and procedures of the Starter Home
  Revitalization Act (SHRA), establish an optional local Starter Home Bonus Program, establish new provisions
  to codify state ministerial requirements related to certain subdivisions in our Zoning Code and update design
  and subdivision standards and extend applicable design standards to Starter Home Bonus Projects.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Find and recommend the City Council find, based on the whole of the record, in the independent judgment
  of the decision maker, that the Small Lot Subdivision Ordinance, the Starter Home Ordinance, the Starter
  Home and Small Lot Design Standards and Map Standards were assessed in the Housing Element
  Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2020-6762-EIR (SCH No. 2021010130) certified on November 29,
  2021, Addendum No. 1 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1) adopted on June 14, 2022, Addendum No. 2 (ENV-
  2020-6762-EIR-ADD2) adopted December 10, 2024, and Addendum No. 5 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD5)
  (collectively, “EIR”); and adopt Addendum No. 5; determine, after consideration of the EIR, that pursuant
  to California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines section 15162 and 15164, no subsequent or
  supplemental EIR is required;
  2. Determine that the Proposed Ordinances are exempt from CEQA pursuant to Public Resources Code
  Sections 21080.085 and 21080.17 and Government Code Sections 65852.21(k), 66411.7(n),
  65852.28(e), 65913.4.5(b), and 66499.41(i), as applicable;
  3. Approve and recommend, pursuant to Chapter 1A Sections 13B.1.3 of the LAMC, that the City Council
  adopt the following amendments to Chapter 1 and Chapter 1A of the LAMC:
  a. The establishment of the Starter Home Ordinance (Exhibit A.3) amending LAMC Chapter 1 Sections
  12.03, 12.21, 12.22 and 19.18, Chapter IV Section 64.11.1, as well as Chapter 1A Articles 7, 9, 13, 14
  and 15; and
  b. An update to the Small Lot Subdivision Amendment Ordinance (Exhibit A.4), amending LAMC Chapter
  1 Section 12.22, as well as Chapter 1A Articles 4 and 14;
  4. Approve and recommend that the City Council adopt the proposed Starter Home and Small Lot Design
  Standards (Exhibit B), subject to subsequent amendment by the City Planning Commission pursuant to
  LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.5;
  5. Adopt the Staff Recommendation Report as the Commission’s report on the subject; and
  6. Adopt the Findings.

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles

  Staff:  Jeanalee Obergfell, City Planner
  planning.missingmiddlela@lacity.org
  (213) 978-0092
summary: The City Planning Commission would recommend citywide zoning changes that update small lot subdivision rules, create a Starter Home ordinance with an optional bonus program, and set related design and subdivision standards to allow more smaller-scale homes.

flag.reason: Citywide small lot and Starter Home rules that could change what gets built in the watched neighborhoods.
